name.zh: X2 Mini 完整共用适配

description.en: Runs the pinned public OXP3 integration once using the package selection, including its explicitly acknowledged OS-image update hold.
description.zh: 按包内显式选择执行一次已公开 OXP3 集成，包含已确认的系统镜像更新暂停。

description.en: Event-driven ALSA Capture Switch synchronization; keeps source mute and gain settings. Restart the desktop session to activate.
description.zh: 按音频事件同步 ALSA 录音开关，保留原生静音和增益设置；重新登录桌面后启用。

name.zh: OXP3 扬声器路由与初始化恢复
name.en: OXP3 speaker route and initialization recovery

description.zh: 在启动会话及休眠恢复后，确认 ALC245 耳机孔为空时修复误选的耳机路由；近期有 Speaker UCM 初始化失败日志时重选原扬声器配置。需要实际声音与耳机插拔验收。
description.en: After session start and resume, repairs a mistaken headphones route only when the ALC245 jack is empty. Retries the unchanged speaker profile after a recent Speaker UCM initialization failure. Physical audio and headset acceptance remain required.

name.zh: OXP3 xe 大量映射休眠恢复修复（可选）

description.zh: 仅限精确 7.2.4 内核和已记录 SteamOS 3.10 build。使用可回退虚拟连续内存分配规避大量 GPU 映射恢复时的单块分配上限。已完成官方 ELF 和离线构建核验，尚无本组件实机加载及休眠验收；已加载模块需重启移除。
description.en: Only for the exact 7.2.4 kernel and recorded SteamOS 3.10 build. Uses virtually contiguous allocation for large GPU mapping rebind arrays. Official ELF and offline build verified; physical loading and suspend acceptance remain pending. An active module requires reboot to remove.

description.zh: 默认开启；下次启动生效。保留 PIN 和已有指纹数据，硬件兼容性尚需验证。
description.en: Enabled by default; active after next boot. PIN and existing fingerprints are retained; hardware compatibility remains unverified.
